title: No test proves gym mates stop seeing a member's workouts when sharing is off or Plus ends
what: The tests check what goes into the shared workout list (bio, workout names, best sets, no photos or body weight), but none checks the switch-off case or the end of MettleUp Plus: that the bio, the workout names and recent workouts stop reaching gym mates.
expected: A test turns 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard' off, and another ends Plus, and checks that nothing more is shared and the old shared workouts can no longer be opened by gym mates.
fix_line: Add a test for sharing switched off and for Plus ending, checking gym mates see nothing new

title: The Recent exercises list is never tested after a workout is deleted
what: The tests check that Recent lists the newest workouts' exercises once each, but none deletes a workout and checks that its exercises leave Recent or that 'Last:' moves to the earlier day. The cap of 15 is not checked either.
expected: A test deletes the newest workout and checks Recent and the 'Last:' day follow the remaining workouts, and that Recent never shows more than 15.
fix_line: Add a deleted-workout case and a 15-item cap case to the recent exercises test

title: 'Start records fresh' is never tested for a never-logged exercise, its error, or its question words
what: The device test presses 'Start records fresh' and 'Count all records again' and the data test checks the records, but no test checks that the row is hidden for an exercise with no workouts, that a failed change shows 'Couldn't change your records. Nothing changed — try again.', or that the questions name the right exercise and day.
expected: Tests check the hidden row for a new exercise, the failure message, and the full words of both questions.
fix_line: Add the new-exercise, failure and question-word checks to the records-fresh tests
